baseline.conditions: Spring route; local guides update root crossings. Wet-season detour adds two days.

title: The path is alive, slowly
daily_life: Guides and bridge crews work between Willowmere and Crownrest. Their songs preserve work sequences; living fibers take seasons to grow.
timing: Six days is the spring guided route; wet-season detour adds two days. Inspection remains necessary even in spring. Roots do not grow a replacement span during a rescue.
handoff: A guide signs off the intended crossing state, not the entire forest. A shift in one crown triggers a fresh choice while other communities continue ordinary work.
story_option: A reliable old instruction now leads to a gap. It can become dangerous without being forged; the actual forgery plot must still supply independent evidence of deliberate alteration.
production: Walking Root Crossing uses the 3.3 footprint, spans and rescue shelf. No unmeasured shortcut is added under the canopy. Show waiting and drying gear as part of the journey.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
